# Vendored libraries

Bundled so netbridgeng runs with no internet access. Each keeps its own license (in `licenses/`).

| File | Project | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `three.min.js`, `OrbitControls.js` | three.js | 0.147.0 | MIT |
| `xterm.js` | xterm.js | 5.3.0 | MIT (its stylesheet is inlined in `index.html`) |
| `xterm-addon-fit.js` | xterm-addon-fit | 0.8.0 | MIT |
| `fonts/chakra-petch-latin-*.woff2` | Chakra Petch (via Fontsource) | 5.3.0 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `fonts/share-tech-mono-latin-400-normal.woff2` | Share Tech Mono (via Fontsource) | 5.3.0 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
